name: Maezono Hotaru
source:
A cheerful high school girl you’d find anywhere. She’s very protective of her younger brother and has a slight sister complex.
Her grades are average, and she’s not very athletic. (Her large breasts get in the way, so she’s not good at running.)
She’s cheerful and has lots of friends. She’s never had a boyfriend,
and she’s never been kissed. She doesn’t have a crush on anyone in particular.
She has strong moral values regarding chastity and has decided to save sex for her future husband.
She’s a virgin.
